issues.issue: What standard applies to an internal flight alternative (IFA) under section 97: serious possibility or balance of probabilities, and is subjective fear needed?
issues.applicant_position: Test should be serious possibility of persecution in the IFA; RPD should have assessed his subjective fear.
issues.result_quote: Applying the lower threshold of a "serious possibility" of persecution for an IFA under section 97 would essentially revise the requirements of section 97.

issues.issue: First prong: could the uncle and his agents locate the applicant in the proposed IFA cities?
issues.applicant_position: Uncle has business contacts and associates in the IFA cities who could trace him; RPD demanded too much proof.
issues.result_quote: There is no error in the RPD's assessment of the risk in the potential IFA locations.

issues.issue: Second prong: would relocation to the IFA cities be objectively unreasonable (employment and living conditions)?
issues.applicant_position: Port Harcourt jobs are mostly oil-sector; without money he would be homeless and unable to pay for medical care.
issues.result_quote: Considering the Appellant's personal circumstances, I do not believe his relocation to the proposed IFA locations would be objectively unreasonable.
